official.application_cycle: 2026 round (applications closed 5 July 2026); the scheme is advertised annually and runs over five years across 1,000 scholarships - 800 fully funded and 200 partially funded
official.status_note: HEC's scholarship pages still carry the 2026 round: the last date for online applications was extended to 5 July 2026. No 2027 dates are published yet; the programme is advertised on an annual cycle, so the next window is expected in 2027 on the same pattern.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Introduction page: 'The Scholarship offers full tuition fee of the Programme for study in Pakistani universities.' Advertisement: 'Fully funded scholarships include tuition fee, maintenance allowance, hostel charges, and book allowances whereas partially funded scholarships include tuition fee only. Additional costs besides the tuition fee will be met by the student.'
benefits: Full tuition fee of the Programme for study in Pakistani universities
Study allowance (advertisement: maintenance allowance and hostel charges)
eligibility: Only Sri Lankan citizens are eligible for the award of scholarship; dual nationals are not eligible
Age limit for BS programmes is 17-22 years; maximum age for graduate and doctoral programmes is 35 years
Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy: GCE A' Levels / equivalent (Pre-Medical) with at least 65% marks
Engineering: GCE A' Levels / equivalent (Pre-Engineering) with at least 65% marks; Bachelor Degree Program: GCE A' Levels / equivalent in required subjects with at least 60% marks

Master Degree Programs: 16 years education in relevant subjects with 60% marks at graduate level; Doctoral Degree Programs: 18 years education in relevant subject with CGPA 3.00/4.00 at Master's level and a research thesis at MS level
The candidate will be required to serve Sri Lanka after completion of education in Pakistan
requirements: Submit the online application within the published window
The candidate must have acquired the requisite qualification on or before the last date of application submission
Candidates must provide an Equivalence Certificate from IBCC and HEC after they are awarded the Allama Iqbal Scholarship
Medium of instruction will be English
Selection will be made purely on merit basis after physical examination of the documents provided by the applicant
documents: Online application form filled and submitted at http://eportal.hec.gov.pk/paksl
Equivalence Certificate from IBCC and HEC, to be provided after the scholarship is awarded
selection_criteria: HEC Scholarship Test - 50% of the merit score
Academic Achievements - 30% of the merit score
Selection purely on merit after physical examination of the documents provided by the applicant
Candidate will be shortlisted based on Aptitude test scores (conducted by HEC) and academic credentials
coverage: Full tuition fee of the Programme for study in Pakistani universities
Partially funded scholarships (200 of the 1,000 places) include tuition fee only
application_method: Fill in the application form online at http://eportal.hec.gov.pk/paksl
All registered candidates appear in a scholarship test organized by HEC in collaboration with the Pakistan High Commission in Colombo and the Sri Lankan Ministry of Higher Education
Shortlisted candidates appear in an interview held at the Pakistan High Commission, Colombo, in collaboration with the Sri Lankan Ministry of Higher Education
official.application_route: Apply online on HEC's ePortal for the advertised cycle, then sit the HEC scholarship test in Sri Lanka and, if shortlisted, the interview at the Pakistan High Commission in Colombo
official.citizenship_residency: Only Sri Lankan citizens are eligible for the award of scholarship; dual nationals are not eligible
official.international_eligibility: Open exclusively to Sri Lankan citizens studying as international students in Pakistan; applicants of any other nationality are not eligible
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Degree programmes in Engineering Science, Basic and Natural Sciences, and Social Sciences. Placement of students will be solely at HEC discretion among the participating universities (11 engineering and 26 general universities listed, plus public sector medical colleges for medicine)
official.research_requirement: For Doctoral Degree Programs a research thesis at MS level is required; PhD applicants need 18 years education with CGPA 3.00/4.00 at Master's level
official.duration: Programme spread over five years across 1,000 scholarships. HEC's advertisement lists Bachelor of Science as a 4-year programme and MS/M.Phil. as 2 years; no PhD duration is stated
official.description: HEC announces the Allama Iqbal Scholarships under the Pak-Sri Lanka Higher Education Cooperation Programme, offering 1,000 Sri Lankan students (800 fully funded and 200 partially funded) the opportunity over five years to pursue undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral degree programmes in Engineering Science, Basic and Natural Sciences, and Social Sciences. Selected candidates study at top-ranked Pakistani universities, and HEC explicitly encourages women candidates to apply.
official.program_type: Government scholarship (international scholarship under the Pak-Sri Lanka Higher Education Cooperation Programme)

verification.notes: HEC publishes benefits only as allowance categories (tuition, accommodation, study, books, return air ticket) with no monetary figures anywhere on the scheme pages or the advertisement, so amount/currency/period are null. No IELTS/TOEFL requirement is published; the Terms & Conditions state only that the medium of instruction will be English. hec.gov.pk was unreachable directly from this environment (connection failures on repeated attempts), so the official pages were read through Internet Archive snapshots of the same hec.gov.pk URLs (June 2026 captures) and corroborated against the live page text returned in search results, which still shows the 5 July 2026 extended deadline; confidence is therefore medium rather than high. Age bands, merit split (50/30/20), terms and conditions, participating universities, subjects list and application route were all confirmed from HEC's own pages.

applicant_utility.summary: HEC runs this as an annual, highly competitive round open only to Sri Lankan citizens, and the 2026 window closed on 5 July 2026 after an extension, so plan for a mid-year opening and watch the AISS page and HEC's ePortal rather than third-party listings. Half of the merit score is the HEC scholarship test sat in Sri Lanka, with academics at 30% and the Colombo interview at only 20%, so test preparation outweighs any other single component. Because placement is solely at HEC's discretion, apply for the discipline you want rather than a named university, and treat the roughly one-in-five partially funded awards (tuition only) as a live possibility when planning your budget.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Sri Lankan citizens aged 17-22 (BS) or up to 35 (MS/PhD) with strong A-Level or degree results in engineering, natural sciences or social sciences who can commit to returning to serve in Sri Lanka after graduating.
application_readiness_checklist: Monitor the AISS page and http://eportal.hec.gov.pk/paksl from around May each year; the 2026 round ran from early June to 5 July
Convert your GCE A-Level results into a percentage using HEC's published 'Formula GCE A Level Grade' document before self-assessing against the 65% and 60% thresholds
Prepare specifically for the HEC scholarship test (50% of merit) and the interview at the Pakistan High Commission in Colombo (20%)
Confirm your age against the closing date: 17-22 for BS, maximum 35 for graduate and doctoral programmes
Verify you hold no other HEC scholarship, since availing another scholarship makes you ineligible
Line up the IBCC and HEC equivalence certificates immediately on award, as they are required after selection
common_rejection_risks: Misinformation or misrepresentation on the application: HEC states the scholarship will be terminated at any stage if the merit list rests on false information
Missing the hard closing date - HEC extended the 2026 date to 5 July but warns that applications in hard-copy form after the date will not be entertained
Underperforming on the 50%-weighted aptitude test despite strong academic results
Age at the closing date falling outside the published bands (17-22 for BS, 35 for graduate and doctoral)
Dual nationality, which the Terms & Conditions exclude outright
Already holding any other HEC scholarship
Not having acquired the requisite qualification on or before the last date of application submission
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: HEC publishes no allowance amounts, so the cash value cannot be budgeted from official pages. The advertisement states that additional costs beyond tuition will be met by the student, and the 200 partially funded awards cover tuition fee only - so living expenses, hostel charges and anything outside the published benefit categories must be self-funded.
document_audit: GCE A-Level grades must be converted into a percentage with HEC's own formula before you can be measured against the 65%/60% cut-offs - do not assume your grading scale converts itself
Keep original certificates and transcripts available for the physical examination of documents HEC performs before selection
The IBCC and HEC equivalence certificates are obtained after the award, not at application, so start that process the moment you are selected to avoid delaying admission
HEC publishes no full document checklist for this scheme; direct questions to info.paksl@hec.gov.pk or +92 51 90808038
alerts: The window is short: the 2026 round opened in early June and closed 5 July 2026, so have documents and test preparation ready before it opens
Placement is solely at HEC's discretion - you cannot choose which Pakistani university you attend
Accepting the award carries an obligation to serve Sri Lanka after completing your education in Pakistan
One in five awards (200 of 1,000) is partially funded and covers tuition fee only
Women candidates are explicitly highly encouraged to apply
Selection is 50% test, 30% academics, 20% interview - a strong academic record alone will not carry the application
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online on HEC's ePortal, sit the HEC scholarship test in Sri Lanka, attend the interview at the Pakistan High Commission in Colombo if shortlisted, then await HEC's merit-based placement and the post-award IBCC/HEC equivalence step.
